$comment: Coverage gates are grouped by capability or behavior, never by release number.
Each group names its source modules and tests and runs as a separate Node test process.
Every managed group asserts 100% line, function and branch coverage.
Platform-only unreachable branches require explicit platform metadata; ordinary modules have no exemptions.

groups.name: trace-storage
groups.branchesNote: trace-archive-store.ts:140 guards chmodSync with `process.platform !== "win32"`. That branch is unreachable on Windows -- a V8 dump confirms it is the single never-executed range in the module, and 98.68% is exactly 75/76 -- so the branch gate is kept where it is reachable (POSIX) and skipped where it measures the platform instead of the code. Line and function coverage stay enforced everywhere.
